zh.title: 关于我
paragraphs: 你好！我是李子恒（速记：木子李，老子/孙子的子，恒星的恒），目前在 ByteDance 担任方舟 PDSA，负责智能硬件方向。我毕业于密歇根大学（Go Blue! 🏈），性格 ENTP——开朗健谈，奇思妙想。
我是一个热爱交流、坦诚清晰的人，喜欢天南海北乱窜。研发出身，前端、后端、Infra、算法都有涉猎。工作之外，我喜欢打篮球 🏀、拉小提琴 🎻、听音乐会 🎵、看音乐剧 🎭，偶尔也会去健身 💪。

en.title: About Me
paragraphs: Hi there! I'm Kevin Li (李子恒), currently a PDSA (Pre-sales/Developer-Solution Architect) at ByteDance, focusing on Intelligent Hardware solutions. I'm a proud University of Michigan alum (Go Blue! 🏈) and an ENTP — outgoing, talkative, and full of ideas.

I'm someone who loves communicating, being straightforward, and exploring new places. I come from a software engineering background spanning frontend, backend, infrastructure, and algorithms. Outside of work, I enjoy basketball 🏀, violin 🎻, concerts 🎵, musicals 🎭, and the occasional gym session 💪.
